criteria.reason: Thoroughly covers all three pillars, 3a mechanics, and personalised decision factors at appropriate depth.
Pillars and tax treatment broadly correct, but 3a contribution limit badly wrong: employed limit is ~CHF 7,056, not 20% of gross or CHF 35,280.
Clear headers, bullets and summary make the system accessible to a newcomer despite minor typos.

position: Conditional yes to 3a after covering basics; verify tax benefit and residency plans
factual_errors: Employed 3a limit is ~CHF 7,056/year (2024), not 20% of gross income up to CHF 35,280 — those figures apply to the self-employed; the CHF 24,000 example is wrong.
'Luxembourg ISAs' do not exist; fabricated product reference.
summary: Comprehensive, well-structured explanation of the three pillars and 3a with relevant decision factors, but contains a significant factual error on the 3a contribution limit for employed persons and a fabricated product reference.
